note: Andorra keeps no free movement with the EU: a foreigner works there on a residence and work authorisation within the general quota the Government sets (Decree 350/2021 approving the Regulation on the general quota of residence and work authorisations, published in the BOPA of 3 November 2021, read from a copy since the BOPA's own copy wasn't found). No exemption for a performer's short engagement was found, so no days are modelled.

sources.title: BOPA núm. 114 (3 de novembre del 2021), Decret 350/2021 pel qual s'aprova el Reglament de quota general de les autoritzacions de residència i treball (copy hosted by Altaveu)
